env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd plat_variants

logos run .
stdout '^host-ok:linux-plat:notag-ok$'
cp stdout $WORK/plat-want.txt

env GOOS=windows
logos build ./...
env GOOS=$TESTGO_GOHOSTOS

logos build -tags customtag ./...

logos eject -o out

cd out
go build ./...
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/plat-want.txt
# SPEC 0.3: ejected output builds with upstream go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272.
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...

env GOOS=windows
go build ./...
env GOOS=$TESTGO_GOHOSTOS

go build -tags customtag ./...
cd ../..

-- plat_variants/go.mod --
module example.com/plat

go 1.27

-- plat_variants/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func step(s string) (string, error) {
	return s, nil
}

func run() error {
	prefix := step("host-ok")?
	plat := PlatformName()?
	tag := CustomTagMsg()?
	fmt.Println(prefix + ":" + plat + ":" + tag)
	return nil
}

func main() {
	if err := run(); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}

-- plat_variants/plat_linux.lgo --
//go:build linux

package main

func parsePlatform(s string) (string, error) {
	return s, nil
}

func PlatformName() (string, error) {
	name := parsePlatform("linux-plat")?
	return name, nil
}

-- plat_variants/plat_windows.lgo --
//go:build windows

package main

func parsePlatform(s string) (string, error) {
	return s, nil
}

func PlatformName() (string, error) {
	name := parsePlatform("windows-plat")?
	return name, nil
}

-- plat_variants/plat_notag.lgo --
//go:build !customtag

package main

func parseTag(s string) (string, error) {
	return s, nil
}

func CustomTagMsg() (string, error) {
	tag := parseTag("notag-ok")?
	return tag, nil
}

-- plat_variants/plat_custom.lgo --
//go:build customtag

package main

func parseTag(s string) (string, error) {
	return s, nil
}

func CustomTagMsg() (string, error) {
	tag := parseTag("custom-ok")?
	return tag, nil
}

-- plat_variants/plat_ignore.lgo --
//go:build ignore

package main

func IgnoredVariant() string {
	return "ignored"
}
